measurement.method: Vertical-gradient projection on a center strip of a street-level photograph. The camera looks steeply up, the podium hides the base, and the facade was not rectified.
measurement.reason: The pass found 40 horizontal peaks. PLUTO records 44 stories. The count does not match, and foreshortening is too strong to scale a sill to the city roof height. No elevation was stored.
